sourceV3.Match_Evidence: Single source record; no matching record found in any other file after cross-file and cross-platform comparison.
sourceV3.Publication_Dataset_Relationship: Reported in source record (relationship not classified)
sourceV3.Label_Taxonomy: Pothole regions with paired RGB, disparity and transformed-disparity representations
sourceV3.Annotation_Source: Disparity estimated with PT-SRP and transformed using the authors' disparity transformation algorithm
sourceV3.AI_Task_Evidence: Reported on the source record/data card or associated publication (see Evidence_Locator)
sourceV3.Key_Limitations: Image count, resolution, country and annotation format are not stated on the Kaggle record (the name implies 600 samples but this is not asserted); no licence file or class list; label modality is inferred only from the linked papers
sourceV3.Related_Datasets: Stereo Pothole Datasets (GitHub, ruirangerfan) - Possible Match, not merged; Pothole Mix (uses this data)
sourceV3.Reconciliation_Notes: Kaggle re-upload of R. Fan stereo pothole data (publications 10.1109/TIP.2018.2808770; 10.1109/TIP.2019.2933750); relationship to the GitHub stereo_pothole_datasets packaging unresolved - kept separate.
sourceV3.Evidence_Locator: Kaggle dataset page 'About Dataset' (ZED stereo acquisition, PT-SRP disparity estimation, disparity transformation, three IEEE citations); Kaggle API record /api/v1/datasets/view/rangerfan/pothole-600; accessed 2026-08-03
sourceV3.V3_AI_Evidence_Note: Pothole-600's author card describes ZED stereo capture and cited disparity processing; MIT is in API metadata. The name does not prove 600 independent potholes, mask labels, numerical depth units or measurement accuracy.
